_origin: Department of Mines and Geology, Government of Nepal, geological map of 1994
_crs: WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), as published — no reprojection applied
_note: Regional belt map. A contact drawn at 1:1,000,000 carries roughly 500 m of positional error, so this can name the unit under a site and cannot place a portal. 'No Data' marks ground this DIGITISATION does not carry, not ground Nepal has not mapped: the printed 1994 sheet covers the whole country, and DMG's 1:350,000 province sheets map 39 tiles' worth of it. Report it as a gap in the data with the published sheet as the remedy, never as an absent answer.
